# Monetization

> GamePasses and developer products with idempotent ProcessReceipt. Needed to sell developer products.

- Package: `Monetization` · Category: Economy & items
- Starts at server boot: **yes, whenever installed** (it has work to do before its first call)
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Monetization")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Monetization`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/MonetizationService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Monetization = GaxiaServer.Monetization
```

### Functions

- `Monetization.RegisterProduct(productId: number, grantFn: GrantFn): ()`
  Register the grant for a Developer Product. grantFn must be deterministic and side-effect-once; idempotency is handled here (it won't be called twice for the same PurchaseId).
- `Monetization.PromptProduct(player: Player, productId: number): ()`
- `Monetization.PromptGamePass(player: Player, gamePassId: number): ()`
- `Monetization.OwnsGamePass(player: Player, gamePassId: number): boolean`
  Cached ownership check (UserOwnsGamePassAsync yields + can error; cache per player).

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Monetization.OnPurchase` — `Signal<Player, number, ReceiptInfo>`
  (player, productId, receiptInfo) after a product's grant succeeded and was recorded
